source.title: Dissipative Softening of Chern Plateaus in a Two-Sector Lattice Dirac Model
source.author: Aaron Alderman

model.phenomenologicalStep: replace i eta by a momentum-independent scalar retarded self-energy i gamma/2
model.berryCurvature: Omega=d dot (partial_kx d cross partial_ky d)/(2|d|^3)

quadratureReproduction.comparisonNote: the released code/formula agrees with the rounded convergence table only to 2.9e-5 at N=100; this is accepted as reproduction of the stated near-quantized quadrature, not bitwise reproduction of the printed table

exactLiouvillian.exceptionalMomenta: kx,ky in {0,pi}; a measure-zero set where H commutes with sigma_z
exactLiouvillian.exactSteadyStateKubo: delta rho=(i omega-L)^(-1) delta L rho_ss=0 and sigma_xy=0
exactLiouvillian.orderOfLimits: taking t to infinity at any gamma>0 gives zero; taking gamma to zero first and preparing the lower band gives the closed-system Chern response

killTest.null: the phenomenological quadrature equals the exact steady-state L=sigma_z Liouvillian Kubo response
killTest.failureCondition: absolute difference greater than the numerical threshold
killTest.interpretation: a nonzero phenomenological value with zero exact response rejects the identification, not the numerical quadrature

missingObjects: the noise or lesser Keldysh component that fixes the stationary distribution
Liouvillian vertex corrections required by the stated jump operator
a non-unital energy-relaxation or reservoir model that preserves a lower-band population
a finite-time preparation-and-readout protocol if the intended observable is transient rather than stationary
consistencyDiagnosis.survivingClaim: the code correctly evaluates the declared phenomenological scalar-self-energy Berry-curvature quadrature and its doubled geometric cusp
consistencyDiagnosis.rejectedClaim: the finite softened curve is the exact steady-state Hall conductivity of the written L=sigma_z Lindblad equation

programmeMapping.A9: use exact Liouvillian response, stationary state and order-of-limits gates before admitting dissipative spectral or transport predictions
programmeMapping.A11: a broadening-only retarded response cannot supply a calibrated positive observable unless the bath, stationary preparation and physical ports are specified
programmeMapping.maximumAdmission: methodological no-go and reusable verifier; no microscopic Spin23 coupling or physical data
